revenue_band: FY2024 revenue £82.0m (Companies House full accounts filed 26 Nov 2024)
ownership_model: Private; venture-backed (investors include General Catalyst, Index Ventures)
product_summary: Next-day and same-day flower delivery across the UK
Flower subscriptions and curated gifting hampers
mission_snippet: We’re here to help you care wildly.
financial_highlights: FY2024 revenue £82.0m; gross profit margin 49% (up 7pp YoY).
Adjusted EBITDA £8.5m and EBITDA £6.6m in FY2024 (up from £1.8m/£0.05m in FY2023).
FY2024 operating profit £4.6m and profit after tax £6.1m, reversing FY2023 losses.
go_to_market_notes: Direct-to-consumer ecommerce model via website and mobile app
Subscription reminders and gifting prompts drive repeat purchases
Operates across UK, Ireland, Germany, France and the Netherlands following Bloomon acquisition
operating_model_insights: Letterbox-friendly packaging enables delivery through standard UK mail slots
Central fulfilment network with growers across the Netherlands, UK and Kenya (per company blog)
Acquired Bloomon in 2021 to scale continental European operations
pain_point_indicators: Trustpilot reviews highlight occasional courier delays and wilted stems on arrival (Data gap – quantify)
Seasonal peaks (Mother’s Day, Valentine’s) stretch capacity and can lengthen delivery windows
tech_stack_notes: Data science and forecasting roles reference Python, SQL and Looker
Marketing technology stack includes Braze for lifecycle communications
data_assets: Delivery performance and courier scan data
Subscription cadence, reminders and marketing engagement
regulatory_notes: GDPR for customer data across UK and EU
Plant health and phytosanitary rules for cross-border flower shipments
Consumer contracts regulations for online gifting
